_comment: Phrase that must appear in each stored document for it to count as genuinely retrieved. Checked on fetch, on manual import, and on every --check. This is the guard that caught a saved page containing 12,493 characters of pure site navigation, which passed a length check. Each phrase must IDENTIFY its document: several earlier values matched four or five files at once, and one matched only the wrong document because two unrelated guidance notes both said 'Issue Six'. Moved out of MANIFEST.csv so the CSV stays readable; it is not optional data.
